t: Clam electric and trophy strike. Same auger? - Ice Fishing Forum - Ice Fishing Forum | In-Depth Outdoors
s: Frictionless World aka the maker of Trophy Strike augers approached Clam about these. A deal was made between the two companies and Frictionless ended up licensing the Clam name for some of their augers. So in short it is a Trophy Strike auger that is just the Clam blue color and has the Clam name and Frictionless World is the one making it.
